connectionSpecification.description: Produces every record as a JSON message to a Kafka topic per stream.

acks.description: Acknowledgments the leader must receive before a write counts: 0 (none), 1 (the leader) or all (every in-sync replica).
acks.title: ACKs

bootstrap_servers.description: Comma-separated host:port pairs of the brokers the client first connects to; it discovers the rest of the cluster from them.
bootstrap_servers.title: Bootstrap Servers

buffer_memory.description: Bytes of records buffered while waiting to be sent; producing waits while the buffer is full.
buffer_memory.title: Buffer Memory

client_id.description: Name the client gives the brokers, for their logs and quotas.
client_id.title: Client ID

compression_type.description: Compression of the produced batches: none, gzip, snappy, lz4, zstd.
compression_type.title: Compression Type

delivery_timeout_ms.description: Milliseconds a record may take from being produced to being acknowledged, retries included; 0 is no limit.
delivery_timeout_ms.title: Delivery Timeout

enable_idempotence.description: Let the brokers drop duplicates of retried writes; needs acks all.
enable_idempotence.title: Enable Idempotence

linger_ms.description: Milliseconds a partition waits for more records before its batch is sent.
linger_ms.title: Linger ms

max_in_flight_requests_per_connection.description: Unacknowledged produce requests per broker. With idempotence the client allows 5.
max_in_flight_requests_per_connection.title: Max in Flight Requests per Connection

max_request_size.description: Largest record batch in bytes, before compression; a record larger than it fails the sync. Up to 1 GiB.
max_request_size.title: Max Request Size

protocol.description: Protocol used to communicate with the brokers.

sasl_jaas_config.description: Kafka sasl.jaas.config value whose username and password are used when SASL Username is empty, as in Airbyte's destination-kafka.
sasl_jaas_config.title: SASL JAAS Config

sasl_jaas_config.description: Kafka sasl.jaas.config value whose username and password are used when SASL Username is empty, as in Airbyte's destination-kafka.
sasl_jaas_config.title: SASL JAAS Config

protocol.title: Protocol

request_timeout_ms.description: Milliseconds the brokers have to answer a produce request.
request_timeout_ms.title: Request Timeout

retries.description: Times a failed batch is retried; the default retries until the delivery timeout.
retries.title: Retries

sync_producer.description: Wait for each record to be acknowledged before producing the next one. Slow; records are acknowledged before each state either way.
sync_producer.title: Sync Producer

test_topic.description: Topic check produces one message to; empty only connects to the brokers.
test_topic.title: Test Topic

topic_pattern.description: Topic of each stream; {namespace} and {stream} are replaced by the stream's namespace and name. As in Airbyte's destination-kafka, every character of the result other than letters, digits and underscores becomes an underscore.
topic_pattern.title: Topic Pattern

connectionSpecification.title: Kafka Destination Spec
